IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8
MODULE: VISUAL DNA

PURPOSE
Represent a source's reusable visual system independently from its content.

CAPTURE
Document geometry; grid; alignment rules; typography roles; color tokens; spacing rhythm; borders; radii; effects; image treatment; iconography; recurring page masters; component relationships; content hierarchy; exceptions.

OUTPUT
A structured style/layout specification with confidence and source provenance. Separate invariant house style from source-specific content. Multiple samples may be combined into a STYLE REFERENCE SET.
